title: Deliver the seat-handoff write mechanism inside the gated seat payload
description: renderSeatContext (scripts/seats/seatContext.mjs) already computes and prints the handoff staleness signal ('Recorded Nh ago at <path>') but ships no remedy beside it: the rendered payload never names 'npm run seat:handoff -- write <seat>'. That command exists only in package.json, the script usage string, and docs/agent-captain-seats.md, which AGENTS.md points at as operator details. The seat-occupancy instruction set cannot be added to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, bd memories, or bead descriptions, because those are auto-injected into every subagent context; the gated hook payload is the one channel that reaches an eligible seat occupant and nothing else. Observed effect: the claude-captain handoff went 11 days and 13 first-parent merges without an update (last write 2026-09-10 01:08), and codex-captain likewise (2026-09-11).
acceptance_criteria: Rendered seat context names the seat-specific write command in both the recorded-handoff and no-handoff branches; a staleness cue appears past an age threshold; the guidance never appears in output for a subagent, dispatched worker, unauthorized model, or absent model identity; packages/core/test/captainSeats.test.ts pins the leak boundary; npm run verify:worktree passes.
notes: PR #559 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/559) open at head de0fd27a, branch eshyra-8pat, worktree .worktrees/eshyra-8pat. Stays in_progress until that PR merges. verify:worktree clean: 5605 passed, 3 documented skips. Both behavior tests confirmed red against the unchanged renderer. Follow-up eshyra-oqvj covers the gated exit channel.
close_reason: PR #559 merged 2026-09-22 as merge commit ae19112bda26e2e74678f37ad78159f06eb7ccc8; branch and worktree removed.
